result:
I've changed sign-up to follow ADR 0003, which outranks the product notes. I haven't run the test suite, and I didn't try any of the reported cases by hand. The only check was that the TypeScript compiles.

- **Names (report 1):** The workspace slug is now derived so it never refuses a sign-up. `Admin`, `Billing`, `Support` and `Taskflow` get a numbered slug (for example `admin-2`). A name that slugifies to under two characters or to nothing (`J`, `山田`) gets `workspace`, suffixed if taken. `Al` works as before.
- **Email case (report 2):** The user repository now lowercases and trims the address on both lookup and insert. Sign-up, sign-in and password-reset request all go through it, so `Alice@Example.com` and `alice@example.com` are one account. Accounts already stored with mixed case aren't migrated.
- **Throttling (report 3):**
  - Sign-up is charged once per attempt on a new `auth:register` bucket, before anything is written. I set it to 10 attempts with 2 refilled per minute; the ADR doesn't give numbers, so that is my choice.
  - Throttled sign-up, sign-in and password-reset confirmation now throw a new `RateLimitedError`, which the error mapper turns into the `rate_limited` code (HTTP 429). The silent password-reset request is unchanged.
- **Existing address (report 4):** Sign-up now throws a new `ConflictError`, which maps to `conflict` (HTTP 409), and creates nothing.
- **Long names (report 5):** The display name is shortened so that `<name>'s workspace` fits the 64-character limit and still ends in `'s workspace`.

The first workspace was already created on the Free plan with an active subscription, so I left that alone. The changes are in `src/server/services/auth-service.ts`, `src/lib/errors.ts`, `src/lib/rate-limit.ts` and `src/server/repositories/user-repository.ts`.
